mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attend_session (courseid, classid, teacherid, checkin_code, title, type, late_minutes, duration, status, start_time, end_time, create_time) VALUES (#{courseid}, #{classid}, #{teacherid}, #{checkinCode}, #{title}, #{type}, #{lateMinutes}, #{duration}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, c.coursename, ci.classname, t.teachername, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student st WHERE st.classid = s.classid) AS total_students, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_attendance sa WHERE sa.session_id = s.id AND sa.status != 4) AS checked_count FROM attend_session s LEFT JOIN course c ON s.courseid = c.courseid LEFT JOIN classinfo ci ON s.classid = ci.classid LEFT JOIN teacher t ON s.teacherid = t.teacherid WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT s.*, c.coursename, ci.classname, t.teachername FROM attend_session s LEFT JOIN course c ON s.courseid = c.courseid LEFT JOIN classinfo ci ON s.classid = ci.classid LEFT JOIN teacher t ON s.teacherid = t.teacherid WHERE s.checkin_code = #{checkinCode} AND s.status = #{status} ORDER BY s.start_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.*, c.coursename, ci.classname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student st WHERE st.classid = s.classid) AS total_students, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_attendance sa WHERE sa.session_id = s.id AND sa.status != 4) AS checked_count FROM attend_session s LEFT JOIN course c ON s.courseid = c.courseid LEFT JOIN classinfo ci ON s.classid = ci.classid WHERE s.teacherid = #{teacherid} ORDER BY s.start_time DESC

SELECT s.*, c.coursename, ci.classname, t.teachername FROM attend_session s LEFT JOIN course c ON s.courseid = c.courseid LEFT JOIN classinfo ci ON s.classid = ci.classid LEFT JOIN teacher t ON s.teacherid = t.teacherid WHERE s.checkin_code = #{checkinCode} AND s.classid = #{classid} AND s.status = 1 AND s.end_time > NOW() ORDER BY s.start_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.*, c.coursename, ci.classname, t.teachername FROM attend_session s LEFT JOIN course c ON s.courseid = c.courseid LEFT JOIN classinfo ci ON s.classid = ci.classid LEFT JOIN teacher t ON s.teacherid = t.teacherid WHERE s.classid = #{classid} AND s.status = 1 AND s.end_time > NOW() ORDER BY s.start_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE attend_session SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE attend_session SET status = 2 WHERE status = 1 AND end_time <= NOW()
